procedures.title: Module B - Safe Handling of Supplies
procedures.briefing: Move the supply box the way you would handle stock on a ward: check it first, carry it under control, put it where it belongs. Dropping it or trying to move fixed equipment counts as an unsafe action.

steps.prompt: Inspect the supply box (look at it and press E) and read its label before moving it.
steps.hint: It is the brown corrugated box resting on a table. Aim the crosshair at it and press E.
steps.explanation: Check what an item is, and what it says on the label, before you lift or move it.

steps.prompt: Pick the box up with a controlled grip (look at it and press G).
steps.hint: Aim at the box and press G. The mouse wheel rotates it while held.
steps.explanation: Lift deliberately and keep the load close and visible; do not rush a carry.

steps.prompt: Carry it to the inspection table and release it (G) on the marked work surface.
steps.hint: The work surface is the highlighted pad on the inspection table. Release the box over it.
steps.explanation: Put supplies down on a stable, intended surface rather than the floor or an unstable spot.

steps.prompt: Return the box to its original storage position (press R while looking at it).
steps.hint: Look at the box and press R to send it back to where it started.
steps.explanation: Supplies go back where they belong so the next person can find them.

unsafeEvents.message: The box hit the floor. Dropped supplies can be damaged or contaminated and are reported according to local policy.
Fixed equipment is not moved by hand. Ask for help and follow local manual-handling policy.

procedures.title: Module D - Infection Prevention Sequence
procedures.briefing: Work through a simple clean-to-dirty sequence: hand hygiene, clean supplies, patient contact, waste disposal, hand hygiene again. Select each item with a left click in the right order.

steps.prompt: Start with hand hygiene: select the hand wash basin.
steps.hint: Look for the hand wash basin on the front wall and left-click it.
steps.explanation: Hand hygiene before preparing supplies and before patient contact is a core infection-prevention step.

steps.prompt: Collect clean supplies: select the medical utility cart.
steps.hint: The utility cart is the wheeled unit with drawers.
steps.explanation: Clean supplies are gathered after hand hygiene so that they are not contaminated.

steps.prompt: Approach the patient: select the hospital bed.
steps.explanation: Patient contact happens after hand hygiene and with clean supplies already prepared.

steps.prompt: Dispose of used items: select the waste bin.
steps.explanation: Used items go straight into the waste container and never back onto clean surfaces.

steps.prompt: Finish with hand hygiene again: select the hand wash basin.
steps.hint: Return to the hand wash basin.
steps.explanation: Hand hygiene after patient contact and waste disposal protects you, the next patient and the environment.
